title: Vocabulary
description: Glossary of terms for catalog filters and interop matrix; used for [i] info popups.

title.description: Optional human-readable label for glossary display; defaults to a formatted version of the term key.

duplicateOf.description: Key of another term describing the same concept. The entry stays available for [i] popups that look it up by key, but is not listed separately in the glossary; its key and aliases become aliases of the target term. Description must match the target.

hidden.description: When true the entry is not listed in the glossary (page, search, sitemap) but stays available for [i] popups and filters that look it up by key.

aliases.description: Synonyms / alternative spellings that should resolve to this term (case-insensitive).
